Text Box 2: Swindon Supermarine formed in 1992 when Swindon Athletic merged with Supermarine, which had grown from a Vickers works team established in 1946.
The Supermarine name reflects a Swindon aircraft-making heritage. The famous Spitfire was designed by the Supermarine company.
The club plays in South Marston, Swindon, at the Imagine Cruising Stadium, formerly known as Webbswood Stadium.
Text Box 3: Marine won promotion to the Southern Premier Division through the 2017/18 play-offs.
Following relegation in 2024/25, the club returned to Southern League Division One South and began rebuilding.
The club reviewed 2025/26 as a season of improvement, particularly after the turn of the year, with development of younger players among its positives.
